pins.definition: Free from dirt, marks, or stains; having tidy habits.

situation: A professional chef is inspecting the stainless-steel surfaces of a high-end restaurant kitchen before service begins.
subject: the clean surface
brief: In a gleaming, industrial kitchen, a chef in a crisp white apron runs a single gloved finger along the edge of a stainless-steel counter. Where the finger has passed, the surface is blindingly reflective and entirely free of any smudge, oil, or streak, contrasting sharply with the duller, slightly hazy sheen of the rest of the metal.
